excerpt.zh: [This.GetName]正在焦点明确的指引下实现了真正和谐的运转。这种万众一心的团结肯定是由于最佳的天象引起的，是伟大的事情即将到来的征兆。
excerpt.en: The [This.GetName] is functioning in true harmony under a directive of unequivocal focus. This unilateral cohesion is certainly due to optimal celestial alignments and is a sign of great things to come.

texts.zh: [This.GetName]正在焦点明确的指引下实现了真正和谐的运转。这种万众一心的团结肯定是由于最佳的天象引起的，是伟大的事情即将到来的征兆。
texts.en: The [This.GetName] is functioning in true harmony under a directive of unequivocal focus. This unilateral cohesion is certainly due to optimal celestial alignments and is a sign of great things to come.

texts.zh: 一种难以言喻的乐观主义席卷了[This.GetAdjective]各星。大众们对自己的生活感到更加满足、舒适和惬意。这种集体情绪的波动毫无疑问是由天象吉兆引起，而且对[This.GetName]而言必须是一个好兆头。
texts.en: An inexplicable air of optimism is washing throughout [This.GetAdjective] worlds. The population is that bit more content, comfortable, and satisfied with their own existence. This collective mood swing is certainly due to optimal celestial alignments, and can only be a good omen for the future of the [This.GetName].

label.en: The stars shine brightly upon us.
